summary: Snow day works in the sandbox: I started it myself and the whole meadow went white with flakes falling and friends hopping. It is cheap, but the wind is barely visible and the invitation-pair test still fails.
surprise_why: A weather event that whitens the whole island is a big twist for a game agent, though the wind is subtle.

findings.what: The wind todo says 'a gust visibly travels across the meadow', but my own live screenshot at 11:25 shows static grass and flowers, and the author's diary admits two shots differ in only a few flower heads. Clouds and the kite are not tied to the wind, which the todo also asked for. Marking it done overstates it.
findings.suggestion: Raise the lean amplitude, add a short clip of the gust wave, and tie the clouds to wind_dir, or reopen the todo.

findings.what: The invitation-pair test (presents.jl) still fails in tests/last_run.json ('fewer than two free friends'), and the diary says it passed only 1 in 4 runs. Four plugins (tag, conga, presents, cairns) were touched without a green result.
findings.evidence: last_run.json 23:30:13: most friends asleep or fishing, no pair could form
findings.suggestion: Have the test skip to a daytime hour with NG.skip_to_hour! and run it three times in a row.

findings.what: Close flakes render as big white discs in the raster (several 10-25 px blobs), and the snow also covers the sand strip. The paint-fight blobs poke through the snow in bright colours, which looks odd but is minor.
findings.evidence: reviews/s72-b.png (snow started via begin!, 1 min in)
findings.suggestion: Shrink or fade flakes by distance to the eye.

Published 23:39. Clouds and the kite still don't follow the wind: the s72 todo #323 was closed too early; the rest is in the wish line in WISHES.md, not claimed done.

The todo stays open until three green runs in a row by day.
